summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Dimensional US Core Equity 1 ETF (DCOR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed to provide broad US equity exposure, seeking to provide long-term capital appreciation by tilting the weightings in the underlying stocks. DCOR was launched on Sep 12, 2023 and is issued by Dimensional.

holdings.infoBox: DCOR is an equity ETF with a total of 2412 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 6.15%, NVIDIA at 6.01%, Microsoft at 4.50%, Alphabet at 3.28%, and Amazon.com at 2.95%.
